title: Greatest World Cup Upsets
description: Giant-killings and shocks that defined World Cup history.

questions.q: Which team stunned Argentina 2–1 in their 2022 group opener?
questions.explain: Saudi Arabia shocked the eventual champions in Qatar.

questions.q: Which team beat both Germany and Spain on their way through the 2022 group stage?
questions.explain: Japan came from behind to beat Germany and Spain to top Group E.

questions.q: Who beat England 1–0 in the 1950 World Cup, one of the biggest shocks ever?
questions.explain: The amateur-laden USA stunned England in Belo Horizonte.

questions.q: Which African side beat reigning champions Argentina in the 1990 opener?
Who beat holders France in the opening match of the 2002 World Cup?
questions.explain: Senegal beat France 1–0 on their World Cup debut.

questions.q: Which team knocked defending champions Germany out in the 2018 group stage?
options: Both Mexico and South Korea beat them
questions.explain: Germany lost to Mexico and South Korea and finished bottom of their group.

questions.q: Which side caused a shock by beating Italy 1–0 in 1966?
questions.explain: North Korea's win over Italy is among the greatest World Cup upsets.

questions.q: Which nation beat West Germany 2–1 in 1982 in a famous result?
questions.explain: Algeria stunned West Germany in their opening game.
